patch_description:
Builds on the previous single-shared-parameter (`theta`) design, which already reached perfect train/val/test accuracy with only 8 trainable parameters (one per outer repetition) and the fastest observed convergence (30 steps) among high-scoring candidates. The core block (RX→RY→alternating XX/CZ nearest-neighbor ring→skip-2 sub-ring→antipodal shortcuts→RZ) is kept unchanged since it is proven to work well and is parameter-optimal (a single shared angle drives every rotation and every non-fixed entangler).

The only structural change is the addition of a lightweight, zero-parameter skip-3 CZ sub-ring (distance-3 links: 0-3, 2-5, 4-7, 6-1) right after the existing skip-2 and antipodal shortcuts inside the main block. This gives an additional layer of long-range, fixed connectivity (complementing the skip-2 and skip-4/antipodal links already present) at a cost of only 4 extra fixed two-qubit gates and no new trainable parameters, which should help spread correlations across the whole register more evenly and can improve generalization / robustness on very small training sets without affecting parameter economy.

The redundant fractional half-register block from the previous version is dropped (it duplicated rotation+entangling work on wires 0-3 without adding new connectivity types), trimming depth/gate-count while keeping the same trainable-parameter count (theta only, still 8 total after the fixed number of outer repetitions). This should preserve or improve the perfect accuracy and fast convergence while reducing depth and gate count, and keeping n_params minimal.
